source_hypotheses.required_input: The fourteen frozen applications require their exact statements, sources and scope qualifications.
source_hypotheses.constructed_input: The complete packet proofs, selected mathematical sources, primary-source catalogue and entire current V16 body are present.
source_hypotheses.justification: Each original construction, application and consumer is mapped below. The introduction retains the conditional source boundary and makes no new source theorem or approval.

constructed_objects.required_input: The source family has214 coordinates and188 primitive integral quadratic residuals, input1 and fixed A_N.
constructed_objects.constructed_input: The TeX prints the214-coordinate dictionary and188 residuals directly from the exact public IR, then defines their sum of squares.
constructed_objects.justification: This is an unexpanded exact row specification, not a full monomial quartic expansion. The actual K,E,P, labels, quarter-trace and fields are those of the frozen source; no222 row weights or extra reductions are counted.

domain_index_coverage.required_input: Every required proof passage and every indexed mathematical domain of the original applications must survive serialization.
domain_index_coverage.constructed_input: The map covers all source lines of the13 proof files, PROOF.md and five selected mathematical fragments; every original14 application passage maps to current TeX.
domain_index_coverage.justification: All214 coordinates and188 rows are printed. Full rational S10 parameters, every coefficient conjugate, all residue primes via3/5, r repeated factors, and the all-N/all-input quantifiers remain explicit. Coverage of recorded text does not establish inventory completeness or mathematical truth.

transition_comparison_maps.required_input: Changes in notation must preserve signs, scalars, roots, exponents, trace maps and the original downstream identities.
transition_comparison_maps.constructed_input: The renderer changes Markdown presentation, local selected-source labels and bibliography aliases, and line endings; the retained current foundation body is exact modulo LF.
transition_comparison_maps.justification: TEX-F01 records actual transcription failures and demands correction of their related occurrences. Exact row transport, source-span comparison and a separate non-author reading must establish fidelity before release; compilation alone is insufficient.

identity_consumed_object.required_input: The consumed polynomial, physical labels, radicals, original representations and H3.1 must be the exact source objects.
identity_consumed_object.constructed_input: The main theorem consumes the actual188-row P_N with213 witnesses; the operative H3 is the product route for the actual A_a over Lprime.
identity_consumed_object.justification: The selected r separate factors replace superseded quotient auxiliaries only at the exact H3.1 interface. The auxiliary evaluation field is not Lprime. All original consumers are bound individually, rather than inferred from a nearby heading.

coefficient_normalization.required_input: Original stable Faltings height, rational/integral lattices, arithmetic Frobenius, valuations and exact coefficients must be retained.
coefficient_normalization.constructed_input: The TeX retains the original conventions, unsaturated specialization C and trace dual, all embeddings and dimension-two isogeny direction.
coefficient_normalization.justification: Long integral coefficients are exact base10 block sums. LF conversion changes no mathematical body text. New notation grouping must preserve each source expression; TEX-F01 and the independent serialization comparison assess that obligation.

local_conditions.required_input: The original split/inert, support, ramification, integrality and pole-preparation hypotheses remain attached to the actual constructed inputs.
local_conditions.constructed_input: Local extraction, complete S10 contact argument, all-prime conductor comparison and fresh pole witnesses are printed in their actual source order.
local_conditions.justification: No new local theorem is applied by typesetting. Source q!=0 guards and reciprocal positivity precede logarithmic integrality; local hypotheses are not inferred from the finite row checker. These remain the original mathematical application obligations.

exceptional_cases.required_input: The assembly must retain every zero/degenerate branch, CM case, radical-one case and historical supersession.
exceptional_cases.constructed_input: The TeX includes zero tests/numerators, delta=0, q!=0 witness restriction, M=1, infinity/deep even contacts, genus/CM restrictions, and the ineffective threshold statements.
exceptional_cases.justification: Introductory and supplier notices identify historical quotient H3 and coarse conductor text as superseded for214. Full V15 results retain their own counts and scope. N>=53 is explicitly coefficient-only, and no full sample witness tuple or effective N0 is asserted.

downstream_consumption.required_input: The final214 theorem needs the exact source joins, uniform N0 and a current reviewed TeX/PDF release binding.
downstream_consumption.constructed_input: The manuscript connects M_j^3|Delta and M_j|J separately, full-family reflected exponent7/6, the actual aggregate SUM bound and N0=max(N_S,N_C).
downstream_consumption.justification: The mapped original14 construction/application/consumer passages preserve the exact suppliers of those joins. Historical acceptance does not accept this editorial adaptation. Actual PDF/build and separately authored decisions are required for release; this author supplies none of those decisions.
